```{r}

# Source figure options, packages, and main data prep.
source("./R/fig-opt-fun.R")
source("./R/packages.R")
source("./R/data-prep.R")
source("./R/helpers.R")

# Settings
refit.models <- FALSE

```



Fatty acids, including EPA (C205n3) and DHA (C226n3), were measured as total fatty acids in frozen whole blood. We will assess the effect of krill oil supplementation on group level fatty acid profiles. As preliminary models indicated heteroscedasticity of residuals, log-transformed and standardized data was used in modelling. This allows for the same weakly regularizing priors for all fatty acids ($\text{FA}$). In addition to each fatty acid, the Omega 3 index [@harris2004] is included in these models as the EPA and DHA content relative to the total fatty acid content of whole blood. The omega 3 index is included in models from model `m3` (see below).    

The models were designed to estimate differences between treatments ($\text{TX}$) at post-treatment time-points (T2 and T4) using pre-treatment ($\text{Pre}_{i[\text{FA}]}$) values as a covariate. The intercept in the model ($\alpha_{\text{[FA, TI, TX]}}$) gives us mean estimates for fatty-acid $\text{FA}$, time-point $\text{TI}$, and treatment $\text{TX}$.


$$
\begin{align}
y_{i[\text{FA}]} &\sim \operatorname{Normal}(\mu_{i[\text{FA}]}, \sigma_{\text{FA}}) \\
\mu_{i[\text{FA}]} &= \alpha_{\text{[FA, TI, TX]}} + \beta_{\text{FA}} \times \text{Pre}_{i[\text{FA}]} \\ 
\alpha_{\text{[FA, TI, TX]}} &\sim \operatorname{Normal}(0, 1) \\
\beta_{\text{FA}} &\sim \operatorname{Normal}(1, 1) \\
\sigma_{\text{FA}} &\sim \operatorname{Exponential}(1)\\
\end{align}
$$



```{r}
#| fig-width: 5
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-cap: "Prior predictive check for target-wise models of post-treatment fatty acid concentrations conditional on pre-treatment values. The model expects log-transformed standardized values and the priors suggest no difference between treatment groups and a proportional relationship between the pre-intervention values and post-intervention measurements."
#| label: fig-m2-priorpred


fat_dat <- AOData::omega3  |>
  inner_join(idkeys) |>
  
  filter(time %in% c("T1", "T2", "T4"), 
         participant %in% total_participants) |>
  select(participant, time, treat, C16:C226n3) |>
  pivot_longer(cols =  C16:C226n3, 
               names_to = "fa", 
               values_to = "value")  |> 
  mutate(.by = fa, 
         value_std = log(value), 
         value_std = (value_std - mean(value_std)) / sd(value_std)) |> 
  mutate(FA = dense_rank(fa), 
         TX = dense_rank(treat)) 
  
  
# Fatty acid summarise  
fat_sum <- fat_dat |> 
    summarise(.by = c(FA,fa), 
              m = mean(log(value)), 
              s = sd(log(value)))
  
  

# Check n 
fat_n <- fat_dat |> 
  distinct(time, treat, participant) |> 
  summarise(.by = c(time, treat), 
            n = n())

# Filter for complete case and prep data 

fat_dat2 <- fat_dat |> 
  select(participant, FA, TX, time, value_std) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = time, values_from = value_std) |> 
  filter(complete.cases(pick(T1:T4))) |> 
  pivot_longer(names_to = "TI", 
               values_to = "y", 
               cols = T2:T4) |> 
  mutate(TI = dense_rank(TI), 
         P = dense_rank(participant))


d <- list(
  # Length of indices
  N    = nrow(fat_dat2), 
  N_FA = length(unique(fat_dat2$FA)),
  N_P  = length(unique(fat_dat2$P)),
  N_TX = length(unique(fat_dat2$TX)),
  N_TI = length(unique(fat_dat2$TI)),
  # Indicators 
  P = fat_dat2$P, 
  FA = fat_dat2$FA, 
  TX = fat_dat2$TX,
  TI = fat_dat2$TI,
  # Co-variate and outcome
  pre = fat_dat2$T1, 
  y = fat_dat2$y, 
  # Prior only flag
  prior_only = 1

)



# Compiling the model
m2 <- cmdstan_model(stan_file = "models/m2.stan", 
                      exe_file = "models/m2.exe")


fit_wrap(m2, fit = "fit.m2", DATA = d)


draws.m2 <- fit.m2$draws(format = "df")


draws.m2 |>
  filter(.chain == 1) |> 
  select(starts_with("alpha"), .iteration) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("alpha")) |> 
  separate(name, into = c("param", "FA", "TI", "TX"), sep = "[,\\[]") |> 
  mutate(TX = gsub("\\]", "", TX)) |> 
  select(- param, 
         .iteration, 
         FA:TX,
         alpha = value, 
         ) |> 
  inner_join(
    draws.m2 |>
      filter(.chain == 1) |> 
      select(starts_with("beta"), .iteration) |> 
      pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("beta")) |>
      separate(name, into = c("param", "FA"), sep = "\\[") |> 
     mutate(FA = gsub("\\]", "", FA)) |> 
        select(- param, 
             .iteration, 
             FA,
             beta = value 
         ) ) |> 

  
  expand_grid(pre = seq(from = -2, to = 2, by = 0.1)) |> 
   
  mutate(mu = alpha + beta * pre) |> 
  
  filter(.iteration %in% sample(1:2000, 50)) |> 
  
  summarise(.by = c(.iteration, FA, TI, TX, pre), 
            m = mean(mu)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(pre, m,  color = TX, 
          
             group = paste(.iteration, TX))) + 
  geom_line() + 
  facet_grid(FA ~ TI, labeller = label_both) + 
  alpha_theme()  + 
  labs(x = "Pre-intervention values (standardized)", 
       y = "Prior predictive distribution of post-intervention values (std.)", 
       color = "Treatment") + 
  scale_color_manual(values = colscale)


```



```{r}
#| fig-width: 5.9
#| fig-height: 5.9
#| fig-cap: "Model performance metrics from Model 2."
#| label: fig-m2-modelperformance


d$prior_only <- 0

# Sample the posterior
fit_wrap(m2, fit = "fit.m2p", DATA = d)


# Model performance
sum.m2 <- fit.m2p$summary()

# Get (most) problematic parameters
vars <- sum.m2 |> 
  arrange(-rhat) |> 
   filter(grepl(paste(
    c("alpha","beta", "sigma"), collapse = "|"), 
               variable)) |> 
  slice_head(n = 3) |> 
  pull(variable)



p1 <- sum.m2 |> 
  filter(grepl(paste(
    c("alpha","beta", "sigma"), collapse = "|"), 
               variable)) |> 
  mutate(variable_type = variable) |> 
  separate(variable_type, into = c("variable_type", "index"), sep = "\\[") |> 
  
  mutate(highlight = if_else(variable %in% vars, variable, "")) |> 
  
  ggplot(aes(ess_bulk, rhat, size = ess_tail, color = variable_type)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = highlight, 
                color = NULL, 
                size = NULL), 
                show.legend = FALSE) +
  
  labs(x = "(Bulk) effective sample size", 
       y = "R-hat", 
       color = "Parameter type", 
       size = "(Tail) effective sample size") +
  scale_color_manual(values = colscale) + 
  alpha_theme()




draws.m2 <- fit.m2p$draws(format = "df")


p2  <- draws.m2 |> 
  select(.iteration, .chain, all_of(vars)) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(vars)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(.iteration, value, 
             color = as.factor(.chain))) + 
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5) + 
  facet_wrap(~ name, ncol = 1, 
             scales = "free_y") + 
  scale_color_manual(values = colscale) + 
  labs(x = "Iteration", 
       color = "Chain", 
       y = "Parameter value") + 
  alpha_theme()



p1 / p2


```


The first model uses only complete-cases. The prior predictive check confirms that the model expects eleven fatty acids, a positive relationship between pre-intervention values and post-treatment values, and no differences in treatments (@fig-m2-priorpred). Sampling from the posterior was non-problematic as R-hat values approached 1 and chains mixed and converged well (@fig-m2-modelperformance).

Posterior predictive checks showed satisfactory patterns between replicated data (y<sup>rep</sup>; thin lines, one per draw in @fig-m2-postpred) and observed data (thick lines in @fig-m2-postpred).


```{r}
#| fig-width: 5.9
#| fig-height: 7.9
#| fig-cap: "Posterior predictive check of Model 2."
#| echo: false
#| label: fig-m2-postpred
#| message: false
#| warning: false


# Posterior predictive check 
draws.m2 |>
  filter(.chain == 1) |> 
  filter(.iteration %in% sample(1:2000, 50)) |> 
  select(starts_with("y_rep"), .iteration) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("y_rep")) |> 
  
  mutate(FA = rep(d$FA, 50), 
         TI = rep(d$TI, 50), 
         TX = rep(d$TX, 50)) |> 
  
  inner_join(fat_sum) |> 

  ggplot(aes(x = value, 
             color = as.factor(TX),
             group = paste(.iteration, TX))) + 
  geom_line(stat = "density", alpha = 0.1) + 
  
  geom_line(data = data.frame(
    value = d$y, 
    FA = d$FA, 
    TI = d$TI, 
    TX = d$TX
  ) |>  inner_join(fat_sum), 
  aes(x = value, group = TX, color = as.factor(TX)), 
  stat = "density", 
  linewidth = 1.2) +
  
  facet_grid(fa ~ TI) +
  alpha_theme() +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = colscale) +
  
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), 
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), 
        axis.title.y = element_blank()) +
  labs(color = "Treatment groups", 
       x = "Observed / Predicted values")
  

```

Krill oil supplementation robustly increased whole blood fatty acid composition levels of C205n3, C225n3 and C226n3 fatty acids compared to placebo (@fig-m2-meanpred and @fig-m2-contrast). Post-treatment values were lower in the krill oil group for C181c9, C183n6, C203n6 and C204n6 with high probability at both T2 and T4 (@fig-m2-contrast). <!-- REVIEW: this complete-case model (m2) result says C181c9 (oleic acid) was lower at both T2 and T4, whereas the inference model m4 (Inference section) finds oleic acid lower at T2 only (T4: -2.8% [-7.3, 4.2] in the last render). Different models, so not necessarily an error, but the reader may see a contradiction; check @fig-m2-contrast for C181c9 at T4. Suggested: "Post-treatment values were lower in the krill oil group for C183n6, C203n6 and C204n6 with high probability at both T2 and T4, and for C181c9 at T2 (@fig-m2-contrast)." -->


```{r}
#| fig-width: 5.9
#| fig-height: 7.9
#| fig-cap: "Predictions of fatty acid concentration in response to treatment. Pre-intervention values are means per treatment group, post-intervention values are posterior medians predicted from the model with 95% PI."
#| label: fig-m2-meanpred




pre_int_means <- fat_dat2 |> 
  filter(TI == 1) |> 
  summarise(.by = FA, 
            pre = mean(T1))


m2_sum <- draws.m2 |>
  filter(.chain == 1) |> 
  select(starts_with("alpha"), .iteration) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("alpha")) |> 
  separate(name, into = c("param", "FA", "TI", "TX"), sep = "[,\\[]") |> 
  mutate(TX = gsub("\\]", "", TX)) |> 
  select(- param, 
         .iteration, 
         FA:TX,
         alpha = value, 
         ) |> 
  
  inner_join(
    draws.m2 |>
      filter(.chain == 1) |> 
      select(starts_with("sigma"), .iteration) |> 
      pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("sigma")) |>
      separate(name, into = c("param", "FA"), sep = "\\[") |> 
     mutate(FA = gsub("\\]", "", FA)) |> 
        select(- param, 
             .iteration, 
             FA,
             sigma = value 
         ) ) |> 
  inner_join(
   draws.m2 |>
      filter(.chain == 1) |> 
      select(starts_with("beta"), .iteration) |> 
      pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("beta")) |>
      separate(name, into = c("param", "FA"), sep = "\\[") |> 
     mutate(FA = gsub("\\]", "", FA)) |> 
        select(- param, 
             .iteration, 
             FA,
             beta = value 
         ) ) |> 
  mutate(FA = as.integer(FA)) |> 
  
  inner_join(pre_int_means) |> 
  rowwise() |> 
  mutate(mu = alpha + beta * pre, 
         y_pred = rnorm(1, alpha + beta * pre, sigma)) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  summarise(
    .by = c(FA, TI, TX), 
    Mu  = median(mu),
    lwr95 = quantile(mu, 0.025),
    upr95 = quantile(mu, 0.975),
    lwr50 = quantile(mu, 0.25), 
    upr50 = quantile(mu, 0.75),
    
    lwr_pred90 = quantile(y_pred, 0.05), 
    upr_pred90 = quantile(y_pred, 0.95) ) |> 
  
  # Back-transform all estimates
  pivot_longer(cols = Mu:upr_pred90, 
               names_to = "est", 
               values_to = "value") |> 
  inner_join(fat_sum) |> 
  
  mutate(value_org = exp(value * s + m)) |> 
  
  select(FA:est, fa, value_org) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = est, 
              values_from = value_org) |> 
  
  mutate(time = if_else(TI == 1, "T2", "T4"), 
         treat = if_else(TX == 1, "ctrl", "omega"), 
         treat = factor(treat, levels = c("ctrl", "omega"), 
                        labels = c("Placebo", "Krill oil"))) |> 

  add_row(
    fat_dat |> 
      filter(time == "T1") |> 
      summarise(.by = c(time, treat, fa), 
                Mu = mean(value)) |> 
      mutate(TX = NA, 
             TI = NA,
             FA = NA, 
              treat = factor(treat, levels = c("ctrl", "omega"), 
                        labels = c("Placebo", "Krill oil"))) 
  ) 
  
  

## Plotting predictions with data  
AOData::omega3  |>
  inner_join(idkeys) |>
  filter(participant %in% fat_dat2$participant)  |> 

  filter(time %in% c("T1", "T2", "T4")) |>
  select(participant, time, treat, C16:C226n3) |>
  pivot_longer(cols =  C16:C226n3, 
               names_to = "fa", 
               values_to = "value") |>
    mutate(treat = factor(treat, levels = c("ctrl", "omega"), 
                        labels = c("Placebo", "Krill oil"))) |> 
  
  
  ggplot(aes(time, value, color = treat, group = paste(participant, fa))) + 
  geom_line(alpha = 0.2) +
  
   ## Add model predictions

  geom_errorbar(data = m2_sum, 
                aes(time, Mu, 
                    ymin = lwr95, 
                    ymax = upr95, 
                    group = treat,
                    color = NULL), 
                width = 0.1, 
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) +
  

    geom_line(data = m2_sum, 
            aes(time, Mu, group = treat, color = NULL), 
            alpha = 1, 
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) +
  

    geom_point(data = m2_sum, 
             aes(time, Mu, fill = treat, group = NULL),
             color = "black",
             size = 3,
             alpha = 1,
             shape = 21, 
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) +

  scale_color_manual(values = colscale) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colscale) +
  
   facet_wrap(~ fa, ncol = 3, scales = "free_y") +
  
  labs(y = "Fatty acid concentration (&mu;g ml<sup>-1</sup>)", 
       x = "Time point", 
       fill = "Treatment", 
       color = "Treatment") + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_markdown(), 
        strip.background = element_rect(color = "white"),   
        strip.text = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 12), 
        legend.position = "inside", 
        legend.position.inside = c(0.85, 0.1))
```

```{r}
### Contrasts
draws.m2 |>
  filter(.chain == 1) |> 
  select(starts_with("alpha"), .iteration) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("alpha")) |> 
  separate(name, into = c("param", "FA", "TI", "TX"), sep = "[,\\[]") |> 
  mutate(TX = gsub("\\]", "", TX)) |> 
  select(- param, 
         .iteration, 
         FA:TX,
         alpha = value, 
         ) |> 
  
  inner_join(
    draws.m2 |>
      filter(.chain == 1) |> 
      select(starts_with("sigma"), .iteration) |> 
      pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("sigma")) |>
      separate(name, into = c("param", "FA"), sep = "\\[") |> 
     mutate(FA = gsub("\\]", "", FA)) |> 
        select(- param, 
             .iteration, 
             FA,
             sigma = value 
         ) ) |> 
  inner_join(
   draws.m2 |>
      filter(.chain == 1) |> 
      select(starts_with("beta"), .iteration) |> 
      pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("beta")) |>
      separate(name, into = c("param", "FA"), sep = "\\[") |> 
     mutate(FA = gsub("\\]", "", FA)) |> 
        select(- param, 
             .iteration, 
             FA,
             beta = value 
         ) ) |> 
  mutate(FA = as.integer(FA)) |> 

    # Compute contrasts
    mutate(treat = if_else(TX == 1, "ctrl", "omega")) |> 
    select(.iteration:TI, treat, alpha) |> 
  
    pivot_wider(names_from = treat, 
                values_from = alpha) |> 

  
        inner_join(fat_sum) |> 

    mutate(contrast = omega - ctrl,
           # Here we need to multiply with the standardization
           rel_contrast = exp(s * contrast), 
           time = if_else(TI == 1, "T2", "T4")) |>
    

    
    ggplot(aes(x = rel_contrast, 
               fill = time)) + 
    geom_density(alpha = 0.2) +
    facet_wrap(~ fa, scales = "free") +
    
    labs(x = "Fold-difference (Krill oil vs. Placebo)", 
         y = "Posterior density", 
         fill = "Time-point") +
    theme_classic() + 
  
  theme(legend.position = c(0.9, 0.2), 
        strip.background = element_blank(), 
        strip.text = element_text(hjust = 0), 
        axis.text.y = element_blank(), 
        axis.line.y = element_blank(), 
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank()) +
  
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, 
             lty = 2, 
             color = "gray50") +


  
  scale_fill_manual(values = colscale)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| label: m3-data-prep
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Preparing data for the imputation model

# Prepare data set with complete cases at baseline, imputation of missing values
# post-treatment.
fat_dat_compl <- AOData::omega3  |>
  inner_join(idkeys) |>
  filter(time %in% c("T1", "T2", "T4"), 
         participant %in% total_participants) |>
  
  # The omega-3 index is modelled as an additional "fatty acid" (FA = 12). FA
  # parameters are independent in m3-m6, so this is equivalent to a separate
  # model of the index.
  select(participant, time, treat, C16:C226n3, omega3index) |>

  pivot_longer(cols =  c(C16:C226n3, omega3index), 
               names_to = "fa", 
               values_to = "value")  |> 
  
  pivot_wider(names_from = time, 
              values_from = value) |> 
  
  # Two participants have no data at T1
  filter(!is.na(T1)) |> 
  pivot_longer(names_to = "time", 
               values_to = "value", 
               cols = T1:T4) |> 
  mutate(.by = fa, 
         value_std = log(value), 
         value_std = (value_std - mean(value_std, na.rm = TRUE)) / 
           sd(value_std, na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
  mutate(FA = dense_rank(fa), 
         TX = dense_rank(treat)) 
  
  
# Fatty acid summarise on complete data (same data as used for 
# standardisation in fat_dat_compl, includes the omega-3 index)
fat_sum_compl <- fat_dat_compl |> 
    summarise(.by = c(FA,fa), 
              m = mean(log(value), na.rm = TRUE), 
              s = sd(log(value), na.rm = TRUE))


# Check n 
fat_n_compl <- fat_dat |> 
  distinct(time, participant) |> 
  summarise(.by = c(time), 
            n = n()) |> 
  mutate(missing = 1 - n / max(n))

totaln_fa <-  round(fat_n_compl[1, 2][[1]], 0)
percent_miss_t2 <- round(100 * fat_n_compl[2, 3][[1]], 0)
percent_miss_t4 <- round(100 * fat_n_compl[3, 3][[1]], 0)

```


Extending the first model with missing data imputations allows us to estimate the effect of treatment on fatty acid profiles with intention-to-treat (ITT) by averaging over the uncertainty associated with the missing values. Missing data imputation is done on post-treatment scores only with the total sample size being n = `r totaln_fa` with `r percent_miss_t2` and `r percent_miss_t4`% of participants missing at time points T2 and T4, respectively.

The imputation mechanism replaces missing values with parameters estimated from observed data (pre-treatment values and treatment allocation) through the likelihood. 

The imputation model is defined as:

$$
\begin{align}
y_{i[\text{FA}]}^\text{all} &\sim \operatorname{Normal}(\mu_{i[\text{FA}]}, \sigma_{\text{FA}}) \\
\mu_{i[\text{FA}]} &= \alpha_{\text{[FA, TI, TX]}} + \beta_{\text{FA}} \times \text{Pre}_{i[\text{FA}]} \\ 
y_{i[\text{FA}]}^{\text{all}} &= 
\begin{cases} 
y_{i[\text{FA}]}^{\text{obs}} & \text{if observed}  \\
y_{i[\text{FA}]}^{\text{mis}} & \text{if missing}
\end{cases} \\
y_{i[\text{FA}]}^{\text{mis}} &\sim \operatorname{Normal}(0,2) \\
\alpha_{\text{[FA, TI, TX]}} &\sim \operatorname{Normal}(0, 1) \\
\beta_{\text{FA}} &\sim \operatorname{Normal}(1, 1) \\
\sigma_{\text{FA}} &\sim \operatorname{Exponential}(1)\\
\end{align}
$$

Prior predictive simulations confirm the general structure of the model (@fig-m3-prior). Model performance metrics from posterior sampling also indicates a functioning model (@fig-m3-performance).


```{r}
#| fig-width: 5.9
#| fig-height: 7.9
#| fig-cap: "Prior predictive check model 3 (data imputation)."
#| echo: false
#| label: fig-m3-prior
#| message: false
#| warning: false



### Data imputation fatty acid profiles ###################

# Filter for complete case and prep data 
fat_dat_compl2 <- fat_dat_compl |> 
  select(participant, FA, TX, time, value_std) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = time, values_from = value_std) |> 

  pivot_longer(names_to = "TI", 
               values_to = "y", 
               cols = T2:T4) |> 
  mutate(TI = dense_rank(TI), 
         P = dense_rank(participant), 
         # Add missing data and fill y
         obs = if_else(is.na(y), 0, 1), 
         y = if_else(is.na(y), -999, y) )




d <- list(
  # Length of indices
  N    = nrow(fat_dat_compl2), 
  N_FA = length(unique(fat_dat_compl2$FA)),
  N_P  = length(unique(fat_dat_compl2$P)),
  N_TX = length(unique(fat_dat_compl2$TX)),
  N_TI = length(unique(fat_dat_compl2$TI)),
  # Indicators 
  P = fat_dat_compl2$P, 
  FA = fat_dat_compl2$FA, 
  TX = fat_dat_compl2$TX,
  TI = fat_dat_compl2$TI,
  # Co-variate and outcome
  pre = fat_dat_compl2$T1, 
  y = fat_dat_compl2$y, 
  obs = fat_dat_compl2$obs,
  # Prior only flag
  prior_only = 1
)


# Compiling the model
m3 <- cmdstan_model(stan_file = "models/m3.stan", 
                      exe_file = "models/m3.exe")


# Prior predictive check
fit_wrap(m3, DATA = d, fit = "fit.m3")

draws.m3 <- fit.m3$draws(format = "df")


draws.m3 |>
  filter(.chain == 1) |> 
  select(starts_with("alpha"), .iteration) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("alpha")) |> 
  separate(name, into = c("param", "FA", "TI", "TX"), sep = "[,\\[]") |> 
  mutate(TX = gsub("\\]", "", TX)) |> 
  select(- param, 
         .iteration, 
         FA:TX,
         alpha = value, 
         ) |> 
  inner_join(
    draws.m3 |>
      filter(.chain == 1) |> 
      select(starts_with("beta"), .iteration) |> 
      pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("beta")) |>
      separate(name, into = c("param", "FA"), sep = "\\[") |> 
     mutate(FA = gsub("\\]", "", FA)) |> 
        select(- param, 
             .iteration, 
             FA,
             beta = value 
         ) ) |> 

  
  expand_grid(pre = seq(from = -2, to = 2, by = 0.1)) |> 
   
  mutate(mu = alpha + beta * pre) |> 
  
  filter(.iteration %in% sample(1:2000, 50)) |> 
  
  summarise(.by = c(FA, TI, TX, pre, .iteration), 
            m = mean(mu)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(pre, m, 
             color = TX, 
             group = paste(.iteration, TX))) + 
  geom_line(alpha = 0.4) + 
  facet_grid(FA ~ TI, labeller = label_both) + 
  labs(x = "Pre-intervention values", 
       y = "Prior predictive distribution of post-intervention values (std.)", 
       color = "Treatment") + 
  
  scale_color_manual(values = colscale) + 
  
  alpha_theme()
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 5.9

Pre-intervention values are observed means, post-treatment (T2, T4) values are model predictions (posterior medians) conditional on pre-intervention value with 95% percentile intervals. The omega-3 index is EPA and DHA content of whole blood expressed as a percent of total identified fatty acids."
#| echo: false
```

```{r}
pre_int_means <- fat_dat_compl2 |> 
  filter(TI == 1) |> 
  summarise(.by = FA, 
            pre = mean(T1))


m3_sum <- draws.m3 |>
  filter(.chain == 1) |> 
  select(starts_with("alpha"), .iteration) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("alpha")) |> 
  separate(name, into = c("param", "FA", "TI", "TX"), sep = "[,\\[]") |> 
  mutate(TX = gsub("\\]", "", TX)) |> 
  select(- param, 
         .iteration, 
         FA:TX,
         alpha = value, 
         ) |> 
  
  inner_join(
    draws.m3 |>
      filter(.chain == 1) |> 
      select(starts_with("sigma"), .iteration) |> 
      pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("sigma")) |>
      separate(name, into = c("param", "FA"), sep = "\\[") |> 
     mutate(FA = gsub("\\]", "", FA)) |> 
        select(- param, 
             .iteration, 
             FA,
             sigma = value 
         ) ) |> 
  inner_join(
   draws.m3 |>
      filter(.chain == 1) |> 
      select(starts_with("beta"), .iteration) |> 
      pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("beta")) |>
      separate(name, into = c("param", "FA"), sep = "\\[") |> 
     mutate(FA = gsub("\\]", "", FA)) |> 
        select(- param, 
             .iteration, 
             FA,
             beta = value 
         ) ) |> 
  mutate(FA = as.integer(FA)) |> 
  

  
  inner_join(pre_int_means) |> 
  rowwise() |> 
  

  mutate(mu = alpha + beta * pre, 
         y_pred = rnorm(1, alpha + beta * pre, sigma)) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  summarise(
    .by = c(FA, TI, TX), 
    Mu  = median(mu),
    lwr95 = quantile(mu, 0.025),
    upr95 = quantile(mu, 0.975),
    lwr50 = quantile(mu, 0.25), 
    upr50 = quantile(mu, 0.75),
    
    lwr_pred90 = quantile(y_pred, 0.05), 
    upr_pred90 = quantile(y_pred, 0.95) ) |> 
  
  # Back-transform all estimates
  pivot_longer(cols = Mu:upr_pred90, 
               names_to = "est", 
               values_to = "value") |> 
  inner_join(fat_sum_compl) |> 

  mutate(value_org = exp(value * s + m)) |> 
  
  select(FA:est, fa, value_org) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = est, 
              values_from = value_org) |> 
  
  mutate(time = if_else(TI == 1, "T2", "T4"), 
         treat = if_else(TX == 1, "ctrl", "omega"), 
         treat = factor(treat, levels = c("ctrl", "omega"), 
                        labels = c("Placebo", "Krill oil"))) |> 
  

  

  add_row(
    fat_dat_compl |> 
      filter(time == "T1") |> 
      summarise(.by = c(time, treat, fa), 
                Mu = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
      mutate(TX = NA, 
             TI = NA,
             FA = NA, 
              treat = factor(treat, levels = c("ctrl", "omega"), 
                        labels = c("Placebo", "Krill oil"))) 
  )
```

### Model expansion: Heterogeneous variance

Model `m3` does not enable treatment- and time-wise heterogeneous variation. In model `m4` we therefore add $\sigma_{\text{[FA, TX]}} \sim \operatorname{Exponential}(1)$, in model `m5` we add  $\sigma_{\text{[FA, TI]}} \sim \operatorname{Exponential}(1)$, and model `m6` adds $\sigma_{\text{[FA, TI, TX]}} \sim \operatorname{Exponential}(1)$. Model performance metrics confirmed that all three extended models provided reliable chain convergence characteristics (@fig-m4-performance). 

```{r}
#| fig-width: 5.9
#| fig-height: 5.9
#| fig-cap: "Prior predictive check of Models 4-6."
#| echo: false
#| label: fig-m4-priorpred
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| include: false
#| eval: false



# Compiling the model
m4 <- cmdstan_model(stan_file = "models/m4.stan", 
                      exe_file = "models/m4.exe")


d$prior_only <- 1

# Prior predictive check
fit_wrap(m4, DATA = d, fit = "fit.m4")

draws.m4 <- fit.m4$draws(format = "df")


draws.m4 |>
  filter(.chain == 1) |> 
  select(starts_with("alpha"), .iteration) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("alpha")) |> 
  separate(name, into = c("param", "FA", "TI", "TX"), sep = "[,\\[]") |> 
  mutate(TX = gsub("\\]", "", TX)) |> 
  select(- param, 
         .iteration, 
         FA:TX,
         alpha = value, 
         ) |> 
  inner_join(
    draws.m4 |>
      filter(.chain == 1) |> 
      select(starts_with("beta"), .iteration) |> 
      pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("beta")) |>
      separate(name, into = c("param", "FA"), sep = "\\[") |> 
     mutate(FA = gsub("\\]", "", FA)) |> 
        select(- param, 
             .iteration, 
             FA,
             beta = value 
         ) ) |> 

  
  expand_grid(pre = seq(from = -2, to = 2, by = 0.1)) |> 
   
  mutate(mu = alpha + beta * pre) |> 
  
  summarise(.by = c(FA, TI, TX, pre), 
            m = mean(mu), 
            lwr = quantile(mu, 0.05), 
            upr = quantile(mu, 0.95)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(pre, m, ymin = lwr, ymax = upr, 
             color = TX, 
             fill = TX)) + 
  geom_line() + 
  geom_ribbon(alpha = 0.2, aes(color = NULL)) + 
  facet_grid(FA ~ TI) + 
  labs(x = "Pre-intervention values", 
       y = "Prior predictive distribution of post-intervention values (std.)", 
       fill = "Treatment", 
       color = "Treatment") + 
  
  scale_color_manual(values = colscale) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = colscale) 



```


```{r}
#| fig-width: 5.9
#| fig-height: 7.4
#| fig-cap: "Model performance metrics models 4, 5, and 6."
#| echo: false
#| label: fig-m4-performance
#| message: false
#| warning: false


m4 <- cmdstan_model(stan_file = "models/m4.stan",
                      exe_file  = "models/m4.exe",
                      compile_model_methods = TRUE)
m5 <- cmdstan_model(stan_file = "models/m5.stan",
                      exe_file  = "models/m5.exe",
                      compile_model_methods = TRUE)
m6 <- cmdstan_model(stan_file = "models/m6.stan",
                      exe_file  = "models/m6.exe",
                      compile_model_methods = TRUE)

d$prior_only <- 0

# Sample from the posterior
fit_wrap(m4, DATA = d, fit = "fit.m4p", iter = 2000)
fit_wrap(m5, DATA = d, fit = "fit.m5p", iter = 2000)
fit_wrap(m6, DATA = d, fit = "fit.m6p", iter = 2000)

# Model performance
sum.m4 <- fit.m4p$summary(.cores = 12)
sum.m5 <- fit.m5p$summary(.cores = 12)
sum.m6 <- fit.m6p$summary(.cores = 12)



# Plot (most) problematic parameters
sum_plot <- function(sum, fit) {
  
  vars <- sum |> 
    filter(grepl(paste(
    c("alpha","beta", "sigma", "y_imp"), collapse = "|"), 
               variable)) |> 
  arrange(-rhat) |> 
  slice_head(n = 3) |> 
  pull(variable)
  
  

  p1 <- sum |> 
  filter(grepl(paste(
    c("alpha","beta", "sigma", "y_imp"), collapse = "|"), 
               variable)) |> 
  mutate(variable_type = variable) |> 
  separate(variable_type, into = c("variable_type", "index"), sep = "\\[") |> 
  
  mutate(highlight = if_else(variable %in% vars, variable, "")) |> 
  
  ggplot(aes(ess_bulk, rhat, size = ess_tail, color = variable_type)) + 
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3) + 
  
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = highlight, 
                color = NULL, 
               
                size = NULL), 
                show.legend = FALSE) +
  
  labs(x = "(Bulk) effective sample size", 
       y = "R-hat", 
       color = "Parameter type", 
       size = "(Tail) effective sample size") +
  scale_color_manual(values = colscale) +
  labs(title = "A") +
    alpha_theme() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
    guides(color=guide_legend(nrow=4, byrow=TRUE), 
           size = guide_legend(nrow=4, byrow=TRUE))




  draws <- fit$draws(format = "df")


  p2  <- draws |> 
  select(.iteration, .chain, all_of(vars)) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(vars)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(.iteration, value, 
             color = as.factor(.chain))) + 
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5) + 
  facet_wrap(~ name, ncol = 1, 
             scales = "free_y") + 
  scale_color_manual(values = colscale) + 
  labs(x = "Iteration", 
       color = "Chain", 
       y = "Parameter value") +
    alpha_theme() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
    guides(color=guide_legend(nrow=2, byrow=TRUE))



  px <- p1 / p2

  
}


p1 <- sum_plot(sum.m4, fit.m4p)
p2 <- sum_plot(sum.m5, fit.m5p)
p3 <- sum_plot(sum.m6, fit.m6p)


p1 + plot_annotation(title = "Model m4") | p2 + plot_annotation(title = "Model m5") |
  p3 + plot_annotation(title = "Model m6")



```


Comparing the models in posterior predictive simulations of condition-specific (time, treatment and fatty-acid) SD across models indicated that no model displayed extreme deviations in replicated values compared to observed variation in the data (@tbl-postpred-m4-m6). This comparison agreed with the out of sample predictive performance where models `m3` to `m5` were comparable. Model `m6`, the most heavily parameterized model showed four unreliable Pareto k values but was also slightly worse in out of sample predictions (@tbl-loo). Together this suggests that model `m4` is the preferred model with model `m6` being the worst model. 


```{r}
#| eval: true
#| label: tbl-postpred-m4-m6
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| echo: false
#| tbl-cap: "Posterior predictive p-values comparing models m3 to m6. "


yreps3 <- fit.m3p$draws("y_rep", format = "df")
yreps4 <- fit.m4p$draws("y_rep", format = "df")
yreps5 <- fit.m5p$draws("y_rep", format = "df")
yreps6 <- fit.m6p$draws("y_rep", format = "df")



dat <- data.frame(
  FA = d$FA, 
  TX = d$TX, 
  TI = d$TI, 
  y = d$y,
  obs = as.character(1:d$N)
) |> 
  filter(y > -900) 
  
  
keep_obs <- dat |> 
  pull(obs)
  

sum_obs <- dat |> 
   summarise(.by = c(FA, TX, TI), 
            s_obs = sd(y)) |> 
  mutate(TI = as.character(TI))

# for code development
ndraws <- 8000

keep_draws <- sample(1:8000, ndraws)

grouped_sd <- function(yreps, model_name) {
  yreps |>
    filter(.draw %in% keep_draws) |>
    pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("y_rep")) |>
    mutate(obs = gsub("y_rep\\[|\\]", "", name)) |>
    filter(obs %in% keep_obs) |>
    inner_join(dat, by = "obs") |>          # name the join key explicitly
    summarise(.by = c(FA, TX, TI, .draw), s = sd(value)) |>
    mutate(model = model_name)
}


models <- list(m3 = yreps3, m4 = yreps4, m5 = yreps5, m6 = yreps6)

ppc_sd <- imap(models, grouped_sd) |>
  bind_rows() |>
  mutate(TI = as.character(TI)) |>
  inner_join(sum_obs, by = c("FA", "TX", "TI"))

# Calculate "p"-values and make to a table

ppc_sd |> 
  summarise(
    .by = c(model, FA, TX, TI),
    p = mean(s >= s_obs),        # obs_sd = observed sd for that cell, from sum_obs
    n_draws = n()
  ) |>
  summarise(
    .by = model,
    prop_extreme = mean(p < 0.05 | p > 0.95),   # fraction of badly-fit cells
    median_p     = median(p),
    min_p        = min(p),
    max_p        = max(p)
  ) |> 
  
  gt()  |> 
  fmt_auto() |> 
  cols_label(
    model = "Model", 
    prop_extreme = md("Proportion extreme p<br>(< 0.05 | > 0.95)"), 
    median_p = "Median p", 
    min_p = "Min p", 
    max_p = "Max p")
  
  


```

```{r}
#| eval: true
#| label: fig-fa-infer
#| fig-cap: "Adjusted group means and treatment contrasts of fatty acids concentrations and the omega-3 index in whole blood. Points in treatment-group means are posterior medians (observed means at T1) and error bars represent 95% percentile intervals, posterior contrasts are displayed as the full posterior distribution ratio between krill oil and placebo estimates at time-point T2 and T4 (1 indicating equivalent concentrations)."
#| fig-width: 3.3

draws <- fit.m4p$draws(format = "df")

### Posterior predictions


pre_int_means <- fat_dat_compl2 |> 
  filter(TI == 1) |> 
  summarise(.by = FA, 
            pre = mean(T1))


sumdat <- draws |>

  select(starts_with("alpha"), .draw) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("alpha")) |> 
  separate(name, into = c("param", "FA", "TI", "TX"), sep = "[,\\[]") |> 
  mutate(TX = gsub("\\]", "", TX)) |> 
  select(- param, 
         .draw, 
         FA:TX,
         alpha = value, 
         ) |> 
  
  inner_join(
    draws |>

      select(starts_with("sigma"), .draw) |> 
      pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("sigma")) |>
      separate(name, into = c("param", "FA"), sep = "\\[") |> 
     mutate(FA = gsub("\\]", "", FA)) |>
      separate(FA, into = c("FA", "TX")) |>
        select(- param, 
             .draw, 
             FA,
             TX,
             sigma = value 
         ) ) |> 
  inner_join(
   draws |>

      select(starts_with("beta"), .draw) |> 
      pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("beta")) |>
      separate(name, into = c("param", "FA"), sep = "\\[") |> 
     mutate(FA = gsub("\\]", "", FA)) |> 
        select(- param, 
             .draw, 
             FA,
             beta = value 
         ) ) |> 
  mutate(FA = as.integer(FA), 
         TX = as.integer(TX)) |> 
  

  
  inner_join(pre_int_means) |> 
  rowwise() |> 


  mutate(mu = alpha + beta * pre, 
         y_pred = rnorm(1, alpha + beta * pre, sigma)) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  summarise(
    .by = c(FA, TI, TX), 
    Mu  = median(mu),
    lwr95 = quantile(mu, 0.025),
    upr95 = quantile(mu, 0.975), 
    lwr50 = quantile(mu, 0.25), 
    upr50 = quantile(mu, 0.75),
    
    lwr_pred95 = quantile(y_pred, 0.025), 
    upr_pred95 = quantile(y_pred, 0.975) ) |> 
  
  # Back-transform all estimates
  pivot_longer(cols = Mu:upr_pred95, 
               names_to = "est", 
               values_to = "value") |> 
  inner_join(fat_sum_compl) |> 


  mutate(value_org = exp(value * s + m)) |> 
  
  select(FA:est, fa, value_org) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = est, 
              values_from = value_org) |> 
  
  mutate(time = if_else(TI == 1, "T2", "T4"), 
         treat = if_else(TX == 1, "ctrl", "omega"), 
         treat = factor(treat, levels = c("ctrl", "omega"), 
                        labels = c("Placebo", "Krill oil"))) |> 
  
  add_row(
    fat_dat_compl |> 
      filter(time == "T1") |> 
      summarise(.by = c(time, fa), 
                Mu = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
      mutate(TX = NA, 
             TI = NA,
             FA = NA) |> 
      expand_grid(treat = c("ctrl", "omega")) |> 
      mutate(treat = factor(treat, levels = c("ctrl", "omega"), 
                        labels = c("Placebo", "Krill oil")))
  )   |> 
    inner_join(fa_labels) 
  

## Plotting predictions without individual data

  theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(),

        strip.background = element_rect(color = "white"),   
        strip.text = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 6), 
        legend.position = "bottom")





### Posterior contrasts

p2 <- draws|>

  select(starts_with("alpha"), .draw) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("alpha")) |> 
  separate(name, into = c("param", "FA", "TI", "TX"), sep = "[,\\[]") |> 
  mutate(TX = gsub("\\]", "", TX)) |> 
  select(- param, 
         .draw, 
         FA:TX,
         alpha = value, 
         ) |> 
  
  inner_join(
    draws |>

      select(starts_with("sigma"), .draw) |> 
      pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("sigma")) |>
      separate(name, into = c("param", "FA"), sep = "\\[") |> 
     mutate(FA = gsub("\\]", "", FA)) |> 
      separate(FA, into = c("FA", "TX")) |> 
        select(
             .draw, 
             FA,
             TX,
             sigma = value 
         ) ) |> 
  inner_join(
   draws |>

      select(starts_with("beta"), .draw) |> 
      pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("beta")) |>
      separate(name, into = c("param", "FA"), sep = "\\[") |> 
     mutate(FA = gsub("\\]", "", FA)) |> 
        select(- param, 
             .draw, 
             FA,
             beta = value 
         ) ) |> 
  mutate(FA = as.integer(FA), 
         TI = as.integer(TI)) |> 

    # Compute contrasts
    mutate(treat = if_else(TX == 1, "ctrl", "omega")) |>

    pivot_wider(names_from = treat,

    facet_wrap(~ fa_lab_unit, scales = "free", ncol = 1) +

    labs(x = "Fold-difference<br>(Krill oil vs. Placebo)", 
         y = "Posterior density", 
         subtitle = "Treatment contrasts<br>(Posterior densities)") +
    alpha_theme(yaxis = FALSE) + 
  
  
  
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.subtitle = element_markdown(size = 8),
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_blank(), 
        axis.title.y = element_blank(), 
        axis.title.x = element_markdown(),
        strip.text = element_blank()) +
  
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, 
             lty = 2, 
             color = "gray50") +


  
  scale_color_manual(values = colscale[c(6, 7)])
```

```{r}
   arrange(fa_lab)
```

Krill oil supplementation led to robust increases in Docosahexaenoic (DHA; time-point T2 krill oil vs. placebo, % difference `r contr_text$stat[contr_text$fa == "C226n3" & contr_text$TI == 1]`; T4, `r contr_text$stat[contr_text$fa == "C226n3" & contr_text$TI == 2]`), Eicosapentaenoic (EPA; T2, `r contr_text$stat[contr_text$fa == "C205n3" & contr_text$TI == 1]`; T4, `r contr_text$stat[contr_text$fa == "C205n3" & contr_text$TI == 2]`), and Docosapentaenoic acid (T2, `r contr_text$stat[contr_text$fa == "C225n3" & contr_text$TI == 1]`; T4, `r contr_text$stat[contr_text$fa == "C225n3" & contr_text$TI == 2]`; @fig-fa-infer, @tbl-infer-fa). At the same time, omega-6 fatty acids were reduced in the krill oil group compared to placebo at both time-points (% difference; Gamma-linolenic acid T2, `r contr_text$stat[contr_text$fa == "C183n6" & contr_text$TI == 1]`; Gamma-linolenic acid T4, `r contr_text$stat[contr_text$fa == "C183n6" & contr_text$TI == 2]`; Arachidonic acid T2, `r contr_text$stat[contr_text$fa == "C204n6" & contr_text$TI == 1]`; Arachidonic acid T4, `r contr_text$stat[contr_text$fa == "C204n6" & contr_text$TI == 2]`; Dihomo-gamma-linolenic acid T2, `r contr_text$stat[contr_text$fa == "C203n6" & contr_text$TI == 1]`; Dihomo-gamma-linolenic acid T4, `r contr_text$stat[contr_text$fa == "C203n6" & contr_text$TI == 2]`; @fig-fa-infer, @tbl-infer-fa). While alpha-linolenic, linoleic, stearic and palmitic acids remained unchanged in krill oil compared to placebo (@fig-fa-infer, @tbl-infer-fa), Oleic acid was reduced in krill oil compared to placebo at T2 (`r contr_text$stat[contr_text$fa == "C181c9" & contr_text$TI == 1]`) but not at T4 (`r contr_text$stat[contr_text$fa == "C181c9" & contr_text$TI == 2]`).

```{r}
#| label: tbl-infer-fa
#| tbl-cap: "Descriptive data (observed mean and SD), adjusted mean estimates (posterior medians with 95% percentile intervals) and treatment contrasts (krill oil minus placebo; posterior medians with 95% percentile intervals) for fatty acids measured in whole blood before the intervention (time-point T1), after supplementation-only (T2), and after supplementation and resistance training (T4). All values are reported on the measurement scale (fatty acids, &mu;g ml<sup>-1</sup>; omega-3 index, %)."


# Descriptive data 

obs_mean <- fat_dat_compl2 |> 
  filter(y != -999) |> 
  mutate(TI = if_else(TI == 1, "T2", "T4")) |> 

  pivot_wider(names_from = TI, values_from = y) |> 
  pivot_longer(names_to = "time", 
               values_to = "y", 
               cols = c("T1", "T2", "T4")) |> 
  inner_join(fat_sum_compl) |> 
  # Back transform
  mutate(conc = exp(y * s + m)) |> 
  # Summarise for observed mean, sd, min-max
  filter(!is.na(conc)) |> 
  summarise(.by = c(fa, TX, time), 
            m = mean(conc, na.rm = TRUE), 
            s = sd(conc, na.rm = TRUE), 
            min = min(conc, na.rm = TRUE), 
            max = max(conc, na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
  
  mutate(.by = fa,
         dec = max(0, 1 - floor(log10(max(m, na.rm = TRUE))))) |> 
  rowwise() |> 
  mutate(m   = formatC(m,   digits = dec, format = "f"),
         s   = formatC(s,   digits = dec, format = "f"),
         min = formatC(min, digits = dec, format = "f"),
         max = formatC(max, digits = dec, format = "f"),
         stat = paste0(m, " (", s, ")")) |> 
  inner_join(fa_labels) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  mutate(TX = if_else(TX == 1, "Placebo", "n3")) |> 
  
  dplyr::select(TI = time, TX, fa_lab, stat) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = c(TX), 
              values_from = stat) |> 
  arrange(fa_lab) |> 
  
  dplyr::select(fa_lab,TI,  Placebo, n3) 



# Adjusted mean, prediction intervals and contrast

adj_mean <- sumdat |> 
  dplyr::select(FA, TI, TX, fa, Mu, lwr95, upr95, lwr_pred95, upr_pred95) |> 
    inner_join(fa_labels) |> 
  dplyr::select(TI, TX, fa_lab, Mu:upr_pred95) |> 
  mutate(TI = if_else(TI == 1, "T2", "T4"), 
         TX = if_else(TX == 1, "Placebo", "n3")) |> 
  filter(!is.na(TI)) |> 
  
  mutate(.by = fa_lab,
         dec = max(0, 1 - floor(log10(max(Mu, na.rm = TRUE))))) |> 
  rowwise() |> 
  mutate(Mu   = formatC(Mu,   digits = dec, format = "f"),
         lwr95   = formatC(lwr95,   digits = dec, format = "f"),
         upr95 = formatC(upr95, digits = dec, format = "f"),
         lwr_pred95 = formatC(lwr_pred95, digits = dec, format = "f"),
         upr_pred95 = formatC(upr_pred95, digits = dec, format = "f"),
         cri = paste0("[", lwr95, ", ", upr95, "]"), 
         pred = paste0("[", lwr_pred95, ", ", upr_pred95, "]"), 
         Mu = paste0(Mu," ", cri)) |> 

  select(fa_lab, TX, TI, Mu, pred) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = c(TX), 
              values_from = Mu:pred)  |> 

  dplyr::select(fa_lab, TI, Mu_Placebo,  Mu_n3) |> 
   arrange(fa_lab) 


contr <- draws|>

  select(starts_with("alpha"), .draw) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("alpha")) |> 
  separate(name, into = c("param", "FA", "TI", "TX"), sep = "[,\\[]") |> 
  mutate(TX = gsub("\\]", "", TX)) |> 
  select(- param, 
         .draw, 
         FA:TX,
         alpha = value, 
         ) |> 
  
  inner_join(
    draws |>

      select(starts_with("sigma"), .draw) |> 
      pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("sigma")) |>
      separate(name, into = c("param", "FA"), sep = "\\[") |> 
     mutate(FA = gsub("\\]", "", FA)) |> 
      separate(FA, into = c("FA", "TX")) |> 
        select(- param, 
             .draw, 
             FA,
             TX,
             sigma = value 
         ) ) |> 
  inner_join(
   draws |>

      select(starts_with("beta"), .draw) |> 
      pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("beta")) |>
      separate(name, into = c("param", "FA"), sep = "\\[") |> 
     mutate(FA = gsub("\\]", "", FA)) |> 
        select(- param, 
             .draw, 
             FA,
             beta = value 
         ) ) |> 
  mutate(FA = as.integer(FA)) |> 
    # Compute contrasts
    mutate(treat = if_else(TX == 1, "ctrl", "omega")) |> 
    select(.draw:TI, treat, alpha) |> 
    inner_join(fat_sum_compl) |> 
  mutate(mu = exp(alpha * s + m)) |> 
  dplyr::select(.draw, fa, TI, treat, mu) |> 
    pivot_wider(names_from = treat, 
                values_from = mu) |> 
     
  mutate(contrast = omega - ctrl,
         time = if_else(TI == 1, "T2", "T4"))  |> 
  summarise(.by = c(fa, TI), 
            m = median(contrast), 
            lwr = quantile(contrast, 0.025), 
            upr = quantile(contrast, 0.975)) |> 
    inner_join(fa_labels) |> 

  mutate(dec = 1) |> 
  rowwise() |> 
  mutate(m   = formatC(m,   digits = dec, format = "f"),
         lwr   = formatC(lwr,   digits = dec, format = "f"),
         upr = formatC(upr, digits = dec, format = "f"), 
         contrast = paste0(m, " [", lwr, ", ", upr,"]")) |> 
  dplyr::select(fa_lab, TI, contrast) |> 
  mutate(TI = if_else(TI == 1, "T2", "T4")) |> 

   arrange(fa_lab) 
  


obs_mean |> 
  inner_join(adj_mean) |> 
  inner_join(contr) |> 

  
  add_row(obs_mean |> 
            filter(TI == "T1")) |> 
    arrange(fa_lab, TI) |> 
  mutate(across(everything(), \(x) if_else(is.na(x), " ", as.character(x)))) |> 

  gt(groupname_col = "fa_lab", row_group_as_column = TRUE) |> 

  cols_label(
    fa_lab = "", 
    TI = "Time-point", 
    Placebo = md("Placebo"), 
    n3 = md("Krill oil"), 
    Mu_Placebo = "Placebo", 
    Mu_n3 = "Krill oil", 
    contrast = "Krill oil vs. placebo"
  ) |> 
  tab_spanner(
    label = md("Observed $\\bar{x}\\text{ }(\\text{SD})$"), 
    columns = c(3, 4)
  ) |> 
  tab_spanner(
    label = md("Estimate $\\mu\\text{ }[95\\%]$"), 
    columns = c(5, 6)
  ) |> 

    tab_spanner(
    label = md("Contrast $[95\\%]$"), 
    columns = c(7)
  ) |> 
    tab_options(
    table.font.size = px(6)
  )
```
